sites.title: Sites
sites.subtitle: The websites whose forms you receive.
sites.search_ph: Search a site or a domain…
sites.empty_hint: Create your first site, then add a form to it.
site.domains_help: Only pages on these domains will be able to submit this site's forms (comma-separated; “example.com” also covers www.example.com, “*.example.com” every subdomain). Leave empty to accept any origin.
site.domains_any_hint: No domain is declared: any website can submit to these forms.
site.forms_empty: This site has no form yet.
site.forms_empty_hint: Create one to get its access key and the code to put on the site.
site.owner_help: The organisation administrator can transfer the site to another user of the organisation. The former owner loses all access.
site.delete_help: Also deletes its forms and all their submissions. Irreversible.
site.delete_confirm: Permanently delete the site “%s”, its forms and all their submissions?
site.err.name_required: The site name is required (120 characters max).
site.err.domains_invalid: Invalid domain: %s. Enter comma-separated domain names (e.g. example.com).
site.tokens.heading: API tokens
site.tokens.intro: A token lets a program, such as an AI agent working on the site's code, create forms on this site and list them. It reads no submission and does not choose who receives them. API address:
site.tokens.created: Token created. Copy it now: it will not be shown again.
site.tokens.col.name: Name
site.tokens.col.creator: Created by
site.tokens.no_access_hint: The account that created this token no longer has access to the site.
site.tokens.revoke_confirm: Revoke the token “%s”? Programs using it will lose access to the API.
site.tokens.help: The name is how you recognise the token in this list. The token acts on your behalf: the forms it creates notify you by email, and it stops working if your account is deactivated or loses access to the site.
site.blocked.heading: Blocked senders
site.blocked.intro: A submission that contains one of these addresses, or an address at one of these domains, is accepted without being stored or sent. The sender is not notified.
site.blocked.help: A domain also blocks its subdomains: example.com covers mail.example.com. An address blocks only that address.
site.blocked.err.invalid: Enter a full email address or a domain name.
site.blocked.err.failed: The block could not be saved. Try again.
site.blocked.err.not_found: This sender is no longer in the blocklist.
site.tokens.err.name: The token name is required (%d characters max.).
site.tokens.err.too_many: This site already has %d tokens: revoke one before creating another.
api.err.unauthorized: Missing, invalid or expired API token.
api.err.rate: Too many calls. Try again in a minute.
api.err.json: Invalid body: a single JSON object is expected.
api.err.too_many_forms: This site already has %d forms: the API will not create more.
form.new.title: New form
form.settings.title: Form settings
form.dest.legend: What should happen to each submission?
form.dest.hint: Pick one of the two destinations, or both.
form.dest.email_desc: Each submission is sent to the recipients below.
form.dest.email_disabled: Outgoing email is not configured on this instance: no notification will be sent until it is.
form.dest.store_desc: Each submission is kept, encrypted, and readable here. Without this option, nothing is stored.
form.dest.store_desc_clear: Each submission is kept and readable here. Warning: no encryption key is set (APP_SECRET_KEY), the content is stored in clear text.
form.include_content: Include the content in the email
form.include_content_desc: Untick so the email only announces the submission, with a link: the data then never leaves this instance. Requires listing submissions.
form.retention_help: After this delay, the submission is deleted automatically. 0 = keep without limit.
form.storage.full_refused: This form has reached its storage quota: new submissions are rejected. Delete submissions to receive new ones.
form.storage.full_email: This form has reached its storage quota: new submissions are no longer kept, they only arrive by email. Delete submissions to keep them again.
form.redirect_help: Where to send the visitor after a submission without JavaScript. Empty: a plain confirmation page is shown.
form.active_desc: Untick to refuse any new submission without deleting the form.
form.attachments_desc: Up to %d files and %d MB per submission. They are attached to the email when it includes the content, and kept with the submission when it is listed.
form.attachments_email_limit: An email carries %d MB at most: beyond that, the files of a listed submission remain available for download here, and a form that does not list rejects them.
form.attachments_scanned: The instance's antivirus scans them first: a submission with a file it recognises is rejected.
form.captcha_desc: Before sending, the visitor's browser solves a computation: they have nothing to do, and no third-party service is involved. The site must load the script given with the integration code. Add it first, then tick this box: without the script, or without JavaScript, submissions are refused.
form.captcha_unsolved: Browser submissions refused for lack of the anti-bot check since the last verified one: %d. If the form's page does not load the check script, all its submissions are refused: send a test message from the site.
form.notification_lang_help: Language of the emails and alerts this form sends, whatever the visitor's language.
form.not_stored_hint: Submissions are only sent by email; nothing is stored here.
form.key_help: The old key stops working immediately: the code on the site will need updating.
form.key_confirm: Regenerate the access key? The form on the site will stop working until the new key is put there.
form.purge_help: Deletes every stored submission of this form. Irreversible.
form.purge_confirm: Permanently delete every submission of this form?
form.delete_help: Also deletes all its submissions. Irreversible.
form.delete_confirm: Permanently delete the form “%s” and all its submissions?
form.flash.created: Form created. Put the code below on your site.
form.flash.captcha_on: Settings saved. The anti-bot check is on: the form's page must load the script from the integration code, otherwise its submissions are refused. Send a test message from the site.
form.flash.key_regenerated: New access key generated: update the code on the site.
form.err.name_required: The form name is required (120 characters max).
form.err.no_destination: Pick at least one destination: notify by email or list submissions.
form.err.recipients_required: Enter at least one recipient for the email notification.
form.err.retention_invalid: The retention period must be between 0 and %d days.
form.err.redirect_invalid: The return page must be a full http(s) address.
form.err.redirect_domain: The return page must be on one of the site's allowed domains.
form.integration.heading: Integration
form.integration.intro: Put this form on your site: keep the submission address and the access key, adapt the fields freely.
form.integration.honeypot_comment: Bot trap: keep it invisible and empty
form.integration.notes:
Service fields (optional, never kept as data): “subject” sets the email subject, “replyto” the reply address (defaults to the “email” field), “redirect” the return page.
Neither the visitor's IP address nor their browser is recorded.
form.integration.files_off: Uploaded files are ignored: this form does not accept attachments (see its settings).
form.integration.files_on: Attachments: up to %d files and %d MB per submission, in “file” inputs with any name. The form must carry enctype="multipart/form-data", and the “access_key” field must come before the file inputs.
form.integration.captcha_comment: Anti-bot check: solves a computation in the browser before sending
form.integration.captcha_on: Anti-bot check: the form carries the “data-naria-captcha” attribute and the page loads the script above, which it may also serve itself. A content security policy must allow %s in “connect-src”, and in “script-src” if the script comes from the instance. In a hand-built submission with files, the “naria_captcha” field comes before the files. Without JavaScript, the form cannot be submitted.
form.chat.hint: On top of the destinations above: a message is posted to the channel for each submission.
form.chat.slack_help: Incoming webhook of a Slack app.
form.chat.teams_help: “Workflows” (Power Automate) webhook: in the channel, Workflows > “Send webhook alerts to a channel”. The old Office 365 connectors no longer work.
form.chat.discord_help: In the channel: Edit Channel > Integrations > Webhooks > “Copy Webhook URL”.
form.chat.telegram_help: Create a bot with @BotFather, which gives you its token, then add that bot to the group or channel. The chat ID is a number (negative for a group or a channel) or @channelname for a public channel.
form.chat.include: Include the content in the message
form.chat.include_desc: Unticked (recommended): the message only announces the submission. Ticked: its content is sent to the chosen service (Slack, Microsoft, Discord, Telegram) and stays there, outside the retention period set here.
form.chat.test_ok: Test message sent to %s. The address is only saved with the “Save” button.
form.chat.test_failed: The %s test failed (%s). Check the webhook address.
form.chat.test_rate: Too many tests. Try again in a few minutes.
form.chat.telegram_test_ok: Test message sent to %s. The token and chat ID are only saved with the “Save” button.
form.chat.telegram_test_failed: The %s test failed (%s). Check the token, the chat ID, and that the bot is in the chat.
form.chat.telegram_test_empty: Enter the bot token and the chat ID first.
form.err.slack_url: Invalid Slack webhook: the address must start with https://hooks.slack.com/
form.err.teams_url: Invalid Teams webhook: a “Workflows” address is required, in https://….api.powerplatform.com/
form.err.discord_url: Invalid Discord webhook: the address copied from Discord is required, in https://discord.com/api/webhooks/…
form.err.telegram_pair: Telegram: the bot token and the chat ID go together. Fill in both, or neither.
form.err.telegram_token: Invalid Telegram token: it looks like 123456789:AA…, as given by @BotFather.
form.err.telegram_chat: Invalid Telegram chat ID: a number (negative for a group or a channel) or @channelname is required.
submissions.heading: Submissions (%d)
submissions.empty_hint: They will show up here as soon as your site sends one.
export.err.busy: Too many exports in progress. Try again in a minute.
export.missing_intro: These attachments could not be read and are missing from the archive:
submission.title: Submission
submission.heading: Submission of %s
submission.unreadable_help: This submission cannot be decrypted: the instance encryption key (APP_SECRET_KEY) has changed since it was received, or the data is corrupted.
submit.ok: Thank you, your message has been sent.
submit.err.unsupported: Unsupported format: send an HTML form or JSON.
submit.err.busy: Too many file uploads in progress. Try again in a moment.
submit.err.full: This form cannot receive messages at the moment.
submit.err.infected: An attached file was rejected by the antivirus: the message was not sent. Send it again without that file.
submit.err.scan_unavailable: The attached files could not be checked: the message was not sent. Try again in a moment, or send it again without a file.
submit.err.files_too_large: The attachments are too large: %d MB at most.
submit.err.key_after_files: The attachments could not be read: the “access_key” field must come before the file inputs.
submit.err.captcha_missing: This form requires an anti-bot check, which your browser did not perform. Make sure JavaScript is enabled, reload the page, then submit the form again.
submit.err.captcha_invalid: The anti-bot check failed or expired. Reload the page, then submit the form again.
submit.err.captcha_after_files: The anti-bot check did not arrive before the attached files. Make sure JavaScript is enabled, reload the page, then submit the form again. The “naria_captcha” field must come before the file inputs.
submit.err.unknown_form: This form does not exist or its access key has changed.
submit.err.inactive: This form no longer accepts messages.
submit.err.origin: This website is not allowed to use this form.
submit.err.rate: Too many submissions. Try again in a few minutes.
submit.err.unavailable: The message could not be delivered. Try again in a moment.
submit.err.internal: Internal error. Try again in a moment.
mail.submission.subject: [%s] New submission: %s
mail.submission.intro: New submission of the form “%s” on the site “%s”.
mail.submission.no_content: Its content is not included in this email: read it in the interface.
mail.submission.not_stored: This submission was not kept: the form has reached its storage quota. It only exists in this email.
mail.submission.files_left: The files of this submission could not be attached to this email: download them from the submission.
mail.quota.subject: [%s] Storage quota reached: %s
mail.quota.intro: The form “%s” on the site “%s” has reached its storage quota.
mail.quota.refused: Until submissions are deleted, new ones are rejected.
mail.quota.email_only: Until submissions are deleted, new ones are no longer kept: they only arrive by email.
mail.captcha.subject: [%s] Submission refused for lack of the anti-bot check: %s
mail.captcha.intro: The form “%s” on the site “%s” refused a visitor's submission: their browser did not perform the anti-bot check.
mail.captcha.note: If the form's page does not load the check script, all its submissions are refused. A bot imitating a browser can also trigger this alert: a test message sent from the site settles it. It is sent at most once a day.
chat.submission.title: New submission: %s
chat.submission.note_email: Its content was sent by email.
chat.test.title: Test message: %s
chat.test.note: This channel will receive an alert for each submission of this form.

orgs.replace_admin_confirm: Replace the administrator of %s? The current administrator becomes a plain user.
users.create_help: The account is created as a user of your organisation. Pass its initial password on outside Naria.
site.shared_notice: This site is shared with you for reading: you see its forms and their submissions, but cannot change it.
site.readers_intro: These users of the organisation read the submissions of every form on this site, without being able to change it.
site.readers_empty: No user can read this site.
